title: Digests
summary: --Digests is a free-floating form subdivision used under legal headings for compilations of brief summaries of statutes, regulations, court decisions, or regulatory agency decisions on particular topics. It is never further subdivided by --Periodicals. LC catalogers (2026) use LCGFT Law digests instead of the form subdivision.
validation_rules: `--Digests` is a free-floating form subdivision (`$v Digests`) used under legal headings for monographic or serial works consisting of systematically arranged compilations of brief summaries of individual statutes, regulations, court decisions, or regulatory agency decisions on particular topics, e.g. `Constitutional law--United States--Digests`; `Criminal law--India--Digests`. (H 1550 sec. D)
Do not further subdivide `--Digests` by `--Periodicals`; `[heading]--Digests--Periodicals` is invalid. (H 1550 sec. D)
`--Digests` follows the legal topic and its geographic subdivision, e.g. `Civil service positions--Classification--Law and legislation--United States--Digests`. (H 1550 sec. E)
[LC practice] LC catalogers no longer use `--Digests`; assign subject headings for the topic of the digest and `655 #7 $a Law digests. $2 lcgft`. (H 1550 sec. A, D)

sections.heading: A. Background
sections.text:
LC practice: As stated in H 1075, LC catalogers will no longer use form subdivisions. Instead assign an appropriate term or terms from Library of Congress Genre/Form Terms (LCGFT), e.g. *Law digests*.

For guidelines on abstracts, see H 1205. For guidelines on bibliographies of individual persons, see H 1322. For guidelines on bio-bibliographies, see H 1328. For guidelines on bibliographies of bibliographies, see H 1325. For catalogs of library materials, see H 1361.

sections.heading: B. Recent revisions
sections.text: 2026-02: Updated template. Added instructions related to LCGFT implementation.

sections.heading: C. Definitions
sections.text: Digests: systematically arranged compilations of brief summaries of individual statutes, regulations, court decisions, or regulatory agency decisions on particular topics

sections.heading: D. General rule
sections.text:
Assign the subdivision *--Digests* as a free-floating form subdivision under legal headings for monographic or serial works consisting of systematically arranged compilations of brief summaries of individual statutes, regulations, court decisions, or regulatory agency decisions on particular topics. Do not further subdivide *--Digests* by *--Periodicals*.

LC practice: Assign subject headings for the topic of the digest. Assign LCGFT appropriate to the form and/or genre of the resource in hand, e.g. LCGFT *Law digests*.

sections.heading: E. Examples
sections.text:
```
Title: Summaries of leading cases on the Constitution.
650 #0 $a Constitutional law $z United States $v Digests.
LC practice:
650 #0 $a Constitutional law $z United States.
655 #7 $a Law digests. $2 lcgft
```

```
Title: Yearly all India criminal digest.
650 #0 $a Criminal law $z India $v Digests.
LC practice:
650 #0 $a Criminal law $z India.
655 #7 $a Law digests. $2 lcgft
```

```
Title: Digest of significant classification decisions and opinions of the U.S. Office of Personnel Management.
650 #0 $a Civil service positions $x Classification $x Law and legislation $z United States $v Digests.
LC practice:
650 #0 $a Civil service positions $x Classification $x Law and legislation $z United States.
655 #7 $a Law digests. $2 lcgft
```
